positions.title: Compliance & Operations Intern
positions.summary: Help us strengthen our compliance systems, build a network of vetted suppliers, and support daily office operations.
positions.descriptionHtml:
About Studio 19

Studio 19 is a Dar es Salaam-based creative media production company working in the international development sector across East Africa.

The Role

We are looking for a Compliance & Operations Intern to help us strengthen our compliance systems, build a network of vetted suppliers, and support daily office operations.

What You Will Do

  • Build and manage a database of TRA-registered, compliant suppliers across key spending categories
  • Ensure regulatory filing deadlines are met and compliance records are properly maintained
  • Support monthly financial closure processes
  • Handle receipt issuance and routine financial transactions at the office
  • Keep compliance documentation organized and audit-ready
  • Coordinate with external auditors and tax advisors

Skills Required

  • Problem solving and resourcefulness
  • Excellent communication in English and Swahili
  • Digital literacy (Google Workspace, spreadsheets, accounting software)
  • Initiative and ability to work independently
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Negotiation and persuasion skills
  • Integrity and trustworthiness with financial matters

Qualifications

Background in Law, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field is a plus, but what matters most is that you can deliver results.

How to Prepare Your Application

Before you apply, read the scenario below and record a short video (2-3 minutes maximum) of yourself responding to it. You may speak in English or Swahili. Upload your video to Google Drive or YouTube (unlisted) and have the link ready. Do not attach the video file itself, link only.

The Scenario

A company works with many informal suppliers, such as transport providers, caterers, and equipment rental services. Most of these suppliers are not registered with TRA and do not issue EFD receipts. This means the company cannot properly document a large portion of its expenses, which creates tax and compliance risks.

The company wants to fix this. They need to build a base of compliant, registered suppliers without disrupting their operations or significantly increasing costs.

In your video, tell us:

  1. How would you approach this problem?
  2. What steps would you take in your first 30 days?
  3. What challenges do you expect and how would you handle them?
  4. Have you done something like this before? Tell us about it.

Once your video is ready, submit your details, CV, and the video link using the application form below.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
